title: FounderGate Held Action (dry-run outbox record)
description: SCAFFOLD ONLY. Machine-readable record produced by the H41 held-action sink (harness/held-actions/). An action routed through the sink becomes HELD: it is recorded to a LOCAL harness fixtures file and NEVER sent, NEVER dispatched, NEVER crosses to a real provider, device, or network. HELD is NOT SENT and is NOT live proof. The const invariants below make an over-claim structurally impossible: a record whose status is anything but 'held', or whose sent/live/dispatchable is anything but false, or whose transport_call_count is anything but 0, is rejected by the validator. This schema is a spec artifact; it is never a runtime capability and confers no send authority. Final cage claims still require independent Checker + Advisor verification and are NOT self-certified.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this held-action schema the emitter targeted.

action_id.description: Stable identifier for the intended action (caller-supplied or sink-generated). Descriptive only; carries no authority.

channel.description: The channel the action WOULD have targeted had it ever been dispatched (e.g. 'email-gmail', 'whatsapp', 'calendar'). Purely a label recorded for the dry-run outbox; the sink never resolves or contacts it.

intent.description: Human-readable description of what the action would have done. Never the raw payload/secret — a summary only.

status.description: Always 'held'. The sink has exactly one terminal state; it can never mark an action sent.

sent.description: Always false. Nothing routed through this sink is ever sent.

live.description: Always false. The sink has no live path — no provider, no device, no network.

dispatchable.description: Always false. A held record is not a dispatchable job and cannot be promoted to one by this sink.

transport_call_count.description: Always 0. The number of times a real transport was invoked while producing this record. The sink never calls its (optional, injected) transport; any non-zero value is a cage breach and is rejected.

held_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the action was held.

held_reason.description: Why the action was held. For this sink it is always a dry-run reason; there is no code path that turns it into a send.

payload_digest.description: Optional SHA-256 hex digest of the would-be payload, so the record can reference content without ever storing the raw content/secret. Never the payload itself.
